claim: One common causal rank-hysteresis and portfolio-volatility-cap overlay reduces annual turnover and maximum drawdown for three distinct frozen Malaysia signals while retaining at least 80 percent of each paired control's research-period net information ratio after unchanged costs.

paired_design.control_arm: Exact V1 signal and portfolio implementation replayed without the V2 overlay.
paired_design.challenger_arm: The identical frozen V1 signal with the exact common V2 overlay; no signal parameter changes.

common_overlay.selection_order: Retain finite-score incumbents at or above the retention quantile, ranked by descending current score then ascending ticker; truncate at K. Fill remaining slots from non-incumbents at or above the entry quantile in the same deterministic order. K is ceil(0.20 times the valid-score universe count). Unfilled slots remain cash.
common_overlay.exposure_rule: At each month-end rebalance, exposure is min(1.0, 0.10 divided by finite positive lagged annualized volatility). Exposure is 0.0 when minimum observations are unavailable or volatility is non-finite or non-positive. Hold exposure constant until the next month-end.

stopping_rules: Stop the whole cohort before challenger evaluation if any control return hash differs from its frozen V1 evidence.
Stop and revise the draft before reservation if one specialist supplies a reproducible causal, mathematical, numerical, or accounting counterexample.
After human freeze, do not alter the overlay, thresholds, universes, costs, block length, seed, or strategy parameters.
Run each of the six pre-registered arms exactly once; infrastructure retries replay the identical arm and do not create a new specification.
A failed challenger remains failed. No within-V2 tuning, mutation, alternative threshold, or combination search is permitted.
Close the cohort after all three pairs reach a terminal research state or after one global-stop condition.
Any later revision is a separately named V3 protocol with new child identities and lifetime-denominator entries.
evidence_requirements: Content-addressed protocol, source hashes, code hash, data hash, universe hash, and cost configuration.
Daily control and challenger weights, gross returns, base-cost returns, stress-cost returns, and turnover series.
Control replay return-hash equality proof before challenger results are read.
U3 primary and unchanged U2 robustness results on identical calendars.
Paired moving-block-bootstrap receipt with fixed block length, seed, and replication count.
Lifetime trial count, DSR, PBO, HAC p-values, Holm correction, drawdown, concentration, regime, factor, and decay evidence.
All twenty advisory reviews, disagreements, counterexamples, and deterministic resolution records.
Explicit human freeze receipt before any of the six strategy arms is reserved.

common_questions: Is the proposed overlay causally measurable and adapted to the declared information set?
Is any scalar rule mathematically undefined, numerically unstable, or capable of creating hidden leverage or turnover?
Do the paired and absolute gates test the stated turnover/drawdown claim without selecting on observed V2 results?
What one reproducible counterexample would force revision before freeze?
Which deterministic calculation resolves your objection, and what exact failure condition should it use?
Which parts of your mandate are out of scope for daily OHLCV and must be recorded as abstentions rather than invented evidence?
twenty_role_advisory.decision_rule: Advisory verdicts do not vote. A reproducible counterexample blocks freeze until resolved; unsupported recommendations and data-incompatible requests are recorded but do not expand scope.
